Correct

Find the instruction that stops the algorithm meeting its requirement, then repair it.

steps.label: Read the Lines Carefully
steps.content:
Read the Lines Carefully

Cambridge pseudocode gives one instruction on each line.

  • Follow the lines from top to bottom.
  • The assignment arrow stores the value on the right in the variable on the left.
  • INPUT gives a value to the algorithm.
  • OUTPUT displays the value currently stored.
  • In an IF block, only the branch whose condition is true runs.
